## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a conventional commit (`feat: ...`, `fix(recorder): ...`, `docs: ...`)
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]` (skip for docs-only or internal changes)
- [ ] Docs changed with the behaviour, in the right Diátaxis place (`docs/README.md` lists them)
- [ ] No client material: no real names, footage, brand assets, fixtures or briefs; the worked example stays fictional
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` contents, saved browser logins or generated media committed
